summary: 40 line icons (heart, bell, check, send, download, play, sparkles, zap, phone, trending-up, wallet, rocket...) that each loop their own hover motion by themselves: ticks draw in, bells swing, arrows spring, lids shake. Plain SVG plus CSS keyframes, so any frame is reproducible from a time.
